WithinHostSFS: Site Frequency Spectrum for within-host variants

Source: R/sfs.R
WithinHostSFS-class.Rd

An S4 class representing the site frequency spectrum (SFS) of within-host variants from deep sequencing data. The SFS bins variant allele frequencies into discrete categories and stores metadata needed for population-genetic inference.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'WithinHostSFS'
show(object)

Arguments

object

A WithinHostSFS object.

Value

An object of class WithinHostSFS, normally created by buildSFS; the show method prints a summary of the spectrum and returns NULL invisibly.

Slots

counts

Integer vector. Number of iSNVs in each frequency bin. Length equals length(breaks) - 1.

breaks

Numeric vector. Bin boundaries. Bins are right-closed, and the lowest break is included in the first bin. Default: 20 equal bins from the detection threshold to the maximum frequency.

folded

Logical scalar. If TRUE, the SFS is folded (minor allele frequency, 0 to 0.5); if FALSE, unfolded: the frequency of the alternative allele, 0 to 1.

polarization

Character scalar: which allele is treated as ancestral. "none" for a folded spectrum, which carries no polarisation; "reference" for an unfolded spectrum built by buildSFS, whose frequencies are those of the alternative allele, so the reference allele stands in for the ancestral one; "outgroup" for a spectrum whose frequencies are of alleles derived relative to an outgroup, which this package does not build but accepts. Statistics that need derived-allele frequencies, such as Fay and Wu's H, refuse "none".

sampleId

Character scalar. Sample identifier.

genomeLength

Integer scalar. Reference genome length.

nSites

Integer scalar. Number of variant sites counted in the spectrum, that is, with a frequency between the lowest and the highest break; buildSFS counts only segregating sites, whose frequency lies strictly between 0 and 1.

meanDepth

Numeric scalar. Typical sequencing depth; buildSFS stores the median depth across sites.

threshold

Numeric scalar. Detection threshold applied (e.g., 0.03). Sites below this are unobservable.

corrected

Logical scalar. Whether ascertainment bias correction has been applied.

maxFreq

Numeric scalar, above 0 and at most 1 (default 1). The highest alternative allele frequency a call could have kept through QC: buildSFS stores the smallest maxFreq among the filters applied with flagISNV when it uses QC-passed calls only, and 1 otherwise. Below 1, the spectrum holds no call above it, so the high-frequency classes are empty by construction; neutralityFromSFS refuses such an unfolded spectrum, and compareSFS compares only spectra with the same value.

See also

buildSFS for constructing from a WithinHostExperiment, neutralityFromSFS for computing all neutrality tests from the SFS.

Examples

data(example_whe)
## a folded spectrum of the first sample, in ten bins from 3% to 50%;
## the summary reports its polarisation, "none" for a folded spectrum,
## and the genome length, read from seqlengths(example_whe)
sfs <- buildSFS(example_whe, sampleIdx = 1L, nBins = 10L)
sfs
#> WithinHostSFS with 15 variants in 10 bins
#>   sample: donor 
#>   folded: TRUE 
#>   polarization: none 
#>   threshold: 0.03 
#>   corrected: FALSE 
#>   genome: 1000 bp
#>   median depth: 1600 x
